subject: Nanotechnology
title: Stain-Resistant Fabrics
description: A micro-lesson that makes Stain-Resistant Fabrics usable.

hook.text: Spill wine on a nano-coated shirt and the droplet rolls off without a trace.

buildup.text: Nanoscale coatings create a rough, low-energy surface that repels liquids on contact.

discovery.text: This mimics the lotus leaf — nano bumps trap air pockets that prevent liquid from wetting the fabric.

twist.text: The coatings wear off with washing — most lose their effect after 20 to 30 wash cycles.

climax.text: Newer bonded coatings last longer by attaching chemically to fibers instead of sitting on top.

punchline.text: Nano bumps turn wine into a rolling ball.

quiz.question: How do nano-coated fabrics repel liquids?
options: They absorb the liquid before it can stain
Nanoscale texture traps air and prevents wetting
An electric charge repels liquid molecules
